parameters.name: BillOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource ownership account. The resource ownership account is the account that actually uses the resource.

parameters.name: BillingCycle
parameters.description: The billing cycle, in the YYYY-MM format.

parameters.name: IsHideZeroCharge
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to filter out bills with a original price (PretaxGrossAmount) of 0. Default value: false (compatible with existing logic). Valid values:
- true: filters out zero-charge bills.
- false: does not filter out zero-charge bills.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300.

parameters.name: SubscriptionType
parameters.description:
The subscription type. Valid values:
- Subscription
- PayAsYouGo

> This parameter must be used together with the ProductCode parameter.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type. Valid values:
- SubscriptionOrder
- PayAsYouGoBill
- Refund
- Adjustment
